scope: Second bounded read-only verification wave using public professional sources. Promotion requires confirmed identity, Saudi-market basis, buying authority, plausible custom-software need, and at least one primary source. Unknown technical capacity is neutral, and likes, follows, reposts, and program attendance alone are not qualification evidence.

scoring_contract.active_rule: No D-band record may be active. A/B records require two independent source objects, including at least one primary or official source.

promoted.name: Mashhoor Aldubayan
promoted.product_stage: pre-MVP; approved architecture and product direction, recruiting the primary founding engineer
promoted.technical_capacity: The role says technology consultants produced architecture and design, while the new hire would be the primary engineer responsible for the first production version. No broader internal engineering team is evidenced.

confirmed_identity.reason: The exact personal profile authored the Wathba hiring post, and the linked venture job identifies Mashhoor as the job poster.

saudi_market_basis.reason: The role calls Wathba an early-stage Saudi startup and locates the work in Riyadh; the venture website describes monthly Riyadh activity.

buying_authority.reason: Mashhoor personally announced the search and is named as the poster for the primary engineer who will implement the venture's approved architecture.

plausible_custom_software_need.reason: The brief requires a custom backend, APIs, data model, authentication, dashboard, integrations, GCP deployment, CI/CD, observability, billing and operational tooling for a new platform.

has_primary_source.reason: Founder-authored, venture job, and venture-site sources are present.

outsourcing_likelihood.reason: The venture explicitly sought an external founding-level engineer to own end-to-end MVP implementation.

budget_readiness.reason: The role is full-time, but no salary, secured funding, paid pilot, revenue, procurement, or software-build budget is disclosed.

timing.reason: The independent job mirror displayed the role as newly listed within the last three weeks at observation time.

source_independence.note: The Sabbar mirror independently preserved the same detailed brief; the founder post, LinkedIn job, and venture site are first-party source objects.

evidence.paraphrased_evidence: Mashhoor states that Wathba is looking for a founding engineer to build an ambitious new product and links to the venture role. LinkedIn displayed the post as approximately two months old.

gaps.detail: Six records passed all active gates and scored C or better. The pass stopped below eight rather than moving established 2019-2021 companies into a stealth/precompany lane.

Several otherwise strong technical-cofounder or founding-engineer listings are marked closed. Their product intent remains useful, but current role availability should be refreshed before any later action.
Mara and Shattara are C-band monitoring leads because public evidence shows internal technical delivery capacity; their inclusion is not evidence of outsourcing likelihood.

Public LinkedIn indexing was incomplete and sometimes rate-limited exact profile pages. Only exact-name verification and public posts/jobs were used; no profile traversal, interaction, contact enrichment, or commercial-search tooling was used.

limitations: Research was read-only and used public professional information only.
No follow, connection, reaction, comment, save, publish, message, form submission, browser extension, contact-detail capture, or automated profile traversal occurred.
LinkedIn relative ages were preserved in evidence prose; published_at is null when an exact publication date was not exposed.
A closed application does not prove that the underlying product need ended, but it also does not prove the role remains available.
